identification: Single pale yellow live-edge sawn slab, roughly 2 m long and 30 to 45 cm wide, chalked 1127 and 23/10/26. It is one of four similar slabs (1126 to 1129) leaning on corrugated iron, all sawn with visible saw ripple. Colour and plain straight grain fit Huon pine but species is not confirmable from one photo; it could be celery top pine or another pale softwood. The slab looks thin (roughly 25 to 40 mm) with wavy bark edges and a few knots.

viewing_check: Confirm species: smell (Huon pine has a strong sweet oil scent), fine even grain, pale yellow, tight growth rings; compare with celery top or other pale softwood. Measure length, width and thickness, check for splits, end checks and worm. Thin or cracked slabs are worth the low end. Compare with neighbouring lots 1126, 1128, 1129, which look similar.
